summary: Corteva filed an 8-K reporting that the Fourth Circuit summarily reversed a District Court order and, on remand, the District Court denied California's motion to enjoin Corteva's separation of its seed segment into Vylor Inc. Corteva's board approved the separation on September 12, 2026, and declared a pro rata dividend of Vylor common stock to Corteva holders of record as of September 24, 2026, with distribution expected before 9:30 a.m. ET on October 1, 2026. Watch for completion mechanics and any renewed legal challenge, given California opposed the split on antitrust grounds.
